activeIssue.rootCause: Health had two identity-composition failures plus one destructive-target boundary failure. Digital Account Footprint grouped by domain plus evidence kind, so one service/domain became multiple top-level entries. Subscription inventory preserved distinct list/sender keys, but the consumer renderer discarded that identity and showed only displayName. The destructive Health cleanup path selected a row by canonical key in the browser but submitted only sender address/domain, so sibling list identities sharing one sender could collide.

preserve distinct actionable subscription identities and render a privacy-safe same-name source differentiator
carry the selected canonical subscription key from rendered Health row through cleanup controller, API and worker
fail closed when destructive cleanup lacks the canonical selected subscription identity
retain sender/domain and age checks as additional narrowing constraints rather than as the destructive identity
add opt-in EMA-15 fixture data isolated from normal fixture/corpus startup
wire a permanent real Chromium acceptance through smoke:browser-scan
